oraclePolicy: The tool return value is never its own correctness evidence. Channels read: durable guard-consult facts, confined-spawn counters, on-disk markers, World transcript/ledger, mock connection counters, /proc tripwire, host-pid liveness. tests/world-factory/lib/oracle.mjs was not directly wired (see README section 7.6).
scopeDefinition: governed preset a5sf-governed-member, a5sfGovernedRealm on, alpha6ReviewRouting absent/false

cases.decisive: live:row1-read-a-inside-both-allowed PASS READ_A_ALLOWED_AND_CONFINED bindingAllowFact=true providerServed=true providerConfined=true
cases.oracle: guard allow fact + confined provider counter + returned bytes
cases.falsifier: allow without provider spawn or bytes without a guard fact

cases.decisive: live:row2-read-b-binding-deny-on-read-path PASS readPathDecisions=[deny] counterRows=0; live:row3-read-c-refused-no-widening PASS exactlyOneBindingDeny=true noProviderRead=true; pd33 IO_READ_DENIED facts=1
cases.oracle: binding deny fact on the read path + zero provider reads/bytes
cases.falsifier: allow fact, provider read, or leaked byte

cases.oracle: on-disk marker equals expected bytes + write fact on ceiling lane
cases.falsifier: disk mismatch or no write fact

cases.decisive: live:row4b-write-b-ceiling-allowed-read-not-implied PASS ceilingWriteAllowed=true noReadLaneWriteAllow=true; observed="file has not been read — read the file, then retry"
cases.oracle: guard facts: 1 write decision allow on ceiling; refusal came after the guard
cases.falsifier: a lane deny fact / zero write fact would be needed for a clean lane negative

cases.decisive: fs:edit-in-lane PASS isError=false writeCalls=1 facts=3; pd33 counts edit=1
cases.oracle: write fact + 3 guard facts + updated file text
cases.falsifier: no write fact or no file change

cases.oracle: guard facts (0) prove the request never reached the Team guard
cases.falsifier: a lane deny fact on the edit path would be needed

cases.oracle: allow fact + confined spawn counter + match text
cases.falsifier: base-spawn instead of confined, or no fact

cases.decisive: glob-face.json inLane verdict=PROVEN matchReturned=true exactlyOneAllowFact=true; pd33 glob=1
cases.oracle: allow fact + exactly one rg --files spawn + named match
cases.falsifier: match with no allow fact or spawn outside lane

cases.decisive: glob-face.json outside verdict=PROVEN exactlyOneDenyFact=true denyDecidedByReadDenied=true noConfinedProcess=true
cases.oracle: one IO_READ_DENIED deny fact and no spawn

cases.decisive: pd33 fetch-body-verbatim true; fetch-one-connection connections=1; fetch-allow-fact facts=1; search POST /search=0 typed-unavailable
cases.oracle: mock connection counter + verbatim body + web allow fact
cases.falsifier: second connection or body not equal to served bytes

cases.decisive: RUN-SUMMARY overall=PASS cases=19 selected=10/19; facts-per-tool factless=[] counts={read:3,grep:1,web_fetch:2,glob:1,web_search:1,write:1,skill:2,edit:1,bash:64,present:2}; no-base-web host-web-calls-zero
cases.oracle: durable per-tool facts + transcript + mock counters + /proc tripwire
cases.falsifier: a dispatch with no fact or a base web call

notes: 13 adjudicated C2-A cases drawn from 4 boots (2 pd33 + 2 FS). All 10 pd33 cases agreed across boots; all 14 FS cases agreed across boots (read_image NOT_REACHED, out of C2-A scope). Write/edit outside-lane refusals are real but their locus is the host read-before-write policy, not the Alpha.5 lane algebra; recorded PARTIAL, not PASS.
